title: BIG DUMB GAMES: Building an Indie Studio Without Waiting for Permission
description: The games industry is facing many challenges, but it is full of experienced, talented people who still want to make great games. Meanwhile, the traditional routes into development feel harder than ever. This talk shares the early story of BIG DUMB GAMES, a new indie “collective” built around a simple question: what if experienced developers stopped waiting for permission and found a fairer way to build something together? Using their first creation, STARSHIP BLOOPERS, Murray talks through collective ownership, contribution credits, and transparent reward sharing.
session_takeaway: How to think about a collective studio model where contributors share in future success without pretending risk doesn't exist.
Practical ways to structure contribution credits and transparent agreements when salaries are a distant dream.
The real-world challenges of building with little or no upfront capital.
